title: Surjective constant coefficient restriction preserves finite local models
statement: On a small site with topology T [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], let f:B to D be a surjective homomorphism of commutative rings. Let F be a sheaf of modules over the constant coefficient D-ring [def-weil-pbc-constant-coefficient-scalar-extension]. If F has local constant finite D-module descriptions [def-weil-pbc-locally-constant-finite-type-modules], its restriction of scalars along the constant-sheaf image of f has local constant finite B-module descriptions. Neither Noetherianity nor derived categories nor boundedness is required.

source.place: Tag 094I: restriction of the coefficient filtration local models; elementary coefficient restriction consequence

proof.text: Construct the comparison between sheafification of a restricted constant presheaf module and restriction of its module sheafification. The two coefficient sheafification units form a commuting square by naturality. The module sheafification adjunction constructs the comparison; forgetting to additive-group sheaves makes it the identity, and the forgetful functor reflects isomorphisms.

Given a finite D-module M, view its scalar restriction N as a B-module. Since f is surjective, RingHom.Finite.of_surjective makes D finite over B. Give N its original D-action and the natural B-D scalar tower; Module.Finite.trans proves N finite over B.

Use the same covering sieve as for F. On each covering slice, scalar restriction commutes with slice restriction by the sectionwise definition. Apply restriction to the chosen trivialization, then compose with the constant-module comparison. The finite restricted module N is the required local model.

theorem locallyConstantFiniteTypeModules_restrictScalars_surjective
    {C : Type u} [Category.{u} C] (T : GrothendieckTopology C)
    {B D : Type u} [CommRing B] [CommRing D] (f : B →+* D)
    (hf : Function.Surjective f)
    (F : SheafOfModules.{u} (constantCoefficientRing T D))
    (h : IsLocallyConstantFiniteTypeModules T D F) :
    IsLocallyConstantFiniteTypeModules T B ((restrictScalars ((sheafCompose T
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).map
        ((constantSheaf T CommRingCat.{u}).map (CommRingCat.ofHom f)))).obj F)
